tools.name: check_autobahn_traffic
tools.title: Autobahn traffic
tools.description: Per motorway (≤ 5), or one Bundesland's motorways with land: an Ampel, then jams, closures, roadworks in force, with place/delay/speed/map.

tools.name: find_cheapest_fuel
tools.title: Cheapest fuel nearby
tools.description: Returns the cheapest stations for one fuel grade near a place or coordinate: price per litre, brand, address, distance, open state.

tools.name: find_fuel_station
tools.title: Find a filling station
tools.description: Finds filling stations around a place or coordinate under any combination of filters — grade, brand, name, open now, open at a time you name, open 24 h — sorted by distance, price or name.

tools.name: find_parking
tools.title: Parking nearby
tools.description: Parking near a place, a coordinate or along one motorway: lorry parks, car parks, P+R and disabled-badge bays, with total spaces, stated amenities (WC, shower) and published free spaces.

tools.name: check_road_status
tools.title: Road status and closures
tools.description: If a motorway/B/Land road (NI, NW, HE, BW, MV, SN, TH; B also SH, BY, BE; pass Land/town as place) is open/closed/restricted now/soon; by place, jams, city/Land messages, Hamburg traffic cameras; lorry limits, Lang-Lkw (vehicle).

tools.name: find_roadworks_ahead
tools.title: Planned roadworks
tools.description: Returns roadworks PLANNED on one motorway, one Bundes-/Landesstraße in NI, NW, HE, BW, MV, SN or TH (BY: B only), or city streets by place, in a date window: where, impact, dates, map links.

tools.name: find_charging_station
tools.title: EV charging nearby
tools.description: Returns EV charging sites near a place or coordinate: operator, plugs, max power, price per kWh where published, and points free now where live status is published.

tools.name: find_hydrogen_station
tools.title: Hydrogen stations nearby
tools.description: Returns hydrogen (H2) filling stations near a place or coordinate, nearest first, with operator, address, pumps (700 bar car, 350 bar truck/bus), opening hours where published and the age of the record.

tools.name: find_speed_cameras
tools.title: Speed enforcement locations (planning)
tools.description: A town's published speed-enforcement locations (fixed, red-light, section control, announced mobile checks, measuring sites) by kind and street plus OpenStreetMap's fixed cameras. § 23 Abs. 1c StVO binds a driver's device use, not…

tools.name: find_place
tools.title: Look up a place
tools.description: Looks up a place name and returns every match, each with its kind, population, English name and coordinate; the official key (AGS/RS) only in the structured result.

tools.name: find_poi
tools.title: Find a named place
tools.description: Finds a business or landmark by name or kind — company, shop, clinic, hotel, hostel — with address, category and coordinate.

tools.name: find_address
tools.title: Look up a street address
tools.description: Looks up a street address: its coordinate, and the named OpenStreetMap objects at it (company, shop, office) or that none are.

tools.name: describe_location
tools.title: Describe a coordinate
tools.description: Turns a coordinate into words: the nearest address, settlement and motorway junction with their distances, and the Gemeinde, Kreis and Land the point lies in; also any low-emission zone.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.title: What is nearby
tools.description: Overview of what is around a place or coordinate: fuel, EV charging, parking, nearest railway station and motorway junction, with distances; everyday places (shop, pharmacy, cash, food, hotel, workshop, police) only when named in…

tools.name: find_sharing
tools.title: Shared bikes nearby
tools.description: Returns rentable shared bikes near a place or coordinate: bike-sharing stations with bikes and free docks now, and free-floating bikes around, with distance and data age (nextbike incl. KVB Rad, MyRadl, VAG_Rad; Donkey Republic).

tools.name: get_driving_rules
tools.title: German driving rules
tools.description: Returns the German road rules a visitor needs: low-emission zones (Umweltzone) and the Feinstaubplakette, speed limits (advisory 130), winter tyres, alcohol, the Sunday lorry ban, tolls, Rettungsgasse, what must be in the car, electric…

tools.name: check_transit_disruption
tools.title: Public-transport disruption in a region
tools.description: Public-transport punctuality now in a German region: share of trips >5 min late, skipped stops, cancellations, trend, alerts in force.

tools.name: check_weather_warnings
tools.title: Weather warnings and road-surface forecast
tools.description: Returns the official DWD weather warnings in force for a place — storm, snow, ice, heavy rain, thunderstorm, heat — with Warnstufe 1–4, area, validity and the official text unaltered.

tools.name: get_train_departures
tools.title: Train departures
tools.description: Next trains at a German railway station: platform, delay, cancellations.

tools.name: get_departures
tools.title: Scheduled departures (bus, tram, train)
tools.description: Scheduled departures from any German stop — bus, tram, U-/S-Bahn, train, ferry — or the nearest stops around a place ("Abfahrten in der Nähe").

tools.name: check_station_facilities
tools.title: Station lifts and escalators
tools.description: Whether the lifts and escalators of a railway station or Köln Stadtbahn stop work now: each with place, state, reason.

tools.name: describe_station
tools.title: Describe a railway station
tools.description: One German railway station as its viafrei.de page shows it: address, step-free platforms now, lifts and escalators (out of service first), platforms, the next departures with live delays, service alerts, parking and charging.

tools.name: watch_situation
tools.title: Watch for a change
tools.description: Opens a watch so THIS conversation is told when something changes: a road closed or restricted, a motorway jam, a stop running late, a weather warning, a charger freeing up.

tools.name: stop_watch
tools.title: Stop a watch
tools.description: Ends a watch this conversation opened with watch_situation, so no further notifications arrive for it.

prompts.name: plan_departure
prompts.description: Briefs a drive that is about to start: the official weather warnings at both ends, whether each motorway is open, and the jams in force this minute, ending in one go/no-go sentence.

prompts.name: compare_travel_options
prompts.description: Weighs one trip by car against the same trip by rail: closures and live jams on the motorway side, the next departures and the region's punctuality on the rail side, as two paragraphs the traveller ca

prompts.name: prepare_car_trip
prompts.description: Collects what a driver must carry and know before driving in Germany and into one particular city: the low-emission-zone badge, speed limits, winter tyres, the alcohol limit, tolls, mandatory equipmen

prompts.name: plan_fuel_stop
prompts.description: Finds where this traveller fills up or charges on the way: the cheapest stations for one fuel grade around one place, or the charging points with the right connector and power, and the rest area besid

prompts.name: plan_commute
prompts.description: Plans one public-transport leg on the day itself: the next departures from the station with delays, platforms and cancellations, and whether the region's buses and trains are running normally at this

prompts.name: plan_arrival_parking
prompts.description: Finds where to leave the car at the end of the drive: the car park in town, the park-and-ride at the edge with the onward departures, or the rest area if the traveller is early.

prompts.name: find_a_place
prompts.description: Resolves a bare name of unknown kind into a place, a named thing, or an address, trying each table in turn and stopping at the first that answers.

prompts.name: plan_local_errand
prompts.description: Answers "what is around here" for one place: the nearest fuel, EV charging, parking, railway station and motorway junction in one glance, then — only if the traveller wants more than the nearest one —

prompts.name: explain_this_coordinate
prompts.description: Turns a bare lat/lon into a sentence a traveller understands: the nearest address, settlement and motorway junction with their distances, and the Gemeinde, Kreis and Land the point lies in.

notCovered: No door-to-door routing or journey planning — ViaFrei answers about places, roads and feeds, never 'how do I get there'.

No city-street traffic beyond the city and Land feeds we carry: street works, closures and traffic messages for Berlin, Cologne (closures for events), Hannover (once its feed publishes), Schleswig-Holstein including Kiel, and Baden-Württemberg including Stuttgart. Other cities are not covered; elsewhere the live traffic we hold is the federal motorway network (Autobahn GmbH) and, where a feed carries them, federal roads, plus roadworks on Land roads in Lower Saxony, Saxony and Thuringia.
No fares, tickets or booking of any kind.

No punctuality figure for one named line — 'is the S1 on time?' is answered train by train at a railway station (the live delay of each departing train, S-Bahn included) and per region with the line's service alerts; a bus, tram or U-Bahn stop gets the timetable only.
No weather forecast — official DWD warnings only, and only while they are in force.
No parking tariffs, and no promise that a space is free unless the operator publishes occupancy (see the parking section).
